extra_quotes: In this work, the field-induced forces in Eq. (14) are coupled to the ionic relaxation procedure. At each ionic step, VASP converges the electronic state at the applied field, evaluates the forces, and passes them to the ionic optimizer to update the atomic positions while maintaining the field.

For AlX (X=P, As, and Sb), the local density approximation (LDA) [58] in the parametrization of Ceperley and Alder [59] was used. We employed a plane-wave cutoff of 500 eV and a Γ-centered 16×16×16 k-point grid
For AgNbO3, the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) [64] approximation was employed for the exchange-correlation functional.
